title: Usage pre-start run estimate static contract schemas
description: Closed shapes for the pre-start estimate owned by Plans/usage-feature.md UF-104 (ledger pldg-20260927-004-wand-memory-plan-usage): estimate(definition) returns either a range estimate with its basis or, when no pricing or latency basis exists, an estimate with no range at all. Both carry source_class pricing_estimated and neither is a UsageRecord: no usage_record_id, usage_event_ref, settlement or quota field is allowed. Each range is [lo, hi]; lo <= hi is a runtime rule these static shapes cannot express. The on-screen words (about, an estimate, not a promise) are presentation and are not stored. Pricing rates stay owned by Plans/Models_System.md section 4.2. Static schema and fixture consistency only; no provider call, pricing lookup, runtime, visual or performance claim.

positive_integer_range.description: [lo, hi] for replies, both at least 1.

estimate_basis.description: The pricing snapshot that priced cost_microdollars and the latency samples that timed duration_s (UF-104).

run_estimate.description: A range estimate with a basis. replies is present only for kinds that count replies.

run_estimate_no_basis.description: With no pricing or latency basis the estimate carries no range, so a surface can show no number and never $0.00. missing_basis names what is absent.
